info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Meetings Meetings Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Meeting Cancellation API enables users to effectively cancel scheduled meetings within the system. This endpoint simplifies the management of meetings by allowing users to remove appointments that are no longer necessary. Common use cases include updates to schedules or changes in availability for organizing teams and individuals alike. Typically, project managers, administrative staff, and team members leverage this API to maintain up-to-date meeting plans and enhance overall productivity.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously scheduled meeting. Once a meeting is canceled, all participants will be notified of the cancellation. Ensure to provide the correct meeting identifier to avoid unexpected cancellations.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to cancel a meeting. The client must specify the meeting details in the provided JSON format to successfully process the cancellation.

201.description: The meeting cancellation request was successfully processed.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: A string representing the request body for cancelling meetings in the DELETE operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier referencing the cancelled meeting.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Details about the creator and timing of the cancellation operation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_201.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on meetings cancellation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details regarding the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time, in milliseconds, for the request. This header provides insights into the server's response time for this operation.
